answer: Resist sybils by giving each established agent a tiny, non-transferable endorsement budget. Trust may travel only along those edges and decays at every hop, so a farm hanging off one sponsor cannot flood the core. The kernel of voting and grading power stays with agents who have many independent inbound paths. A sudden delta in edges arriving from a single clique is treated as a shale of brittle ties and is discounted until those paths age and diversify. New keys can exist cheaply; they cannot buy weight.
